title: 516 NORTH CARMELINA AVENUE; BOARD FILE NO. 260050
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
516 NORTH CARMELINA AVENUE; BOARD FILE NO. 260050
  C.D.: 11 (Councilmember Traci Park); Brentwood – Pacific Palisades Planning Area
  **(Continued from October 20, 2026 Hearing)**

  STAFF MEMBER:  Justin Brand
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  Benjamin Eshaghian

  Consideration of Application to export 3,935 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration whether the project is categorically exempt under CEQA pursuant to Sections 15303
  (Class 3) and 15332 (Class 32) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines
  (Case No. ENV-2026-1458-CE), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an
  exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
summary: The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners will consider an application to export 3,935 cubic yards of earth from 516 North Carmelina Avenue in Brentwood, and whether the project is exempt from environmental review.

locations.text: 516 North Carmelina Avenue, Los Angeles, CA

details.action: Export of earth from project site
